title: Roots on the Graph
brief:
plots: y = 2x² – 5x + 3 as a line chart with markers
x values: 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3
series 'y': 3.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 3.0, 6.0
html:
<script>
const c = Visual.chart({ x: [0, 3], y: [-1, 7], xLabel: "x", yLabel: "y" });
const data = [[0, 3], [0.5, 1], [1, 0], [1.5, 0], [2, 1], [2.5, 3], [3, 6]];
const f = x => 2 * x * x - 5 * x + 3;
const roots = data.filter(p => p[1] === 0);
const said = {
  0: "Here, at the start, x equals 0.",
  1: "Let's check.",
  1.5: "Last, here at x equals 1.5."
};
let n = 0;

function draw() {
  c.clear();
  const y = f(n);
  c.fn(f, { color: "var(--muted)", dashed: true });
  c.line(data);
  c.dots(data);
  c.dots(roots, { color: "var(--good)" });
  c.vline(n);
  c.dots([[n, y]], { color: "var(--warn)" });
  // label sits low and away from the y-axis so it never collides with tick labels
  c.label(Math.min(Math.max(n, 0.5), 2.5), -0.7, `x = ${n}`);
  c.readout([
    `x = ${n}`,
    `y = 2x² – 5x + 3 = ${y}`,
    y === 0 ? "On the x-axis: a root" : "Not a root yet"
  ]);
  const base = `At x = ${n}, y = ${y}.`;
  Visual.state(said[n] ? `${said[n]} ${base}` : base);
}

Visual.on("x", v => { n = v; draw(); });
draw();
</script>
